methodology.rows: uniform without replacement, sorted; identical batches for every method
methodology.timed: page planning + reads + row copy; persistent readers, reserved buffers
methodology.scope: raw table row I/O only; no scales, hot-row cache, FIFO or GPU transfers
methodology.mb: decimal MB of requested unique 4096-byte pages; not physical device bytes
methodology.device_counters: whole device; other processes can contribute
methodology.p99: NumPy linear percentile; smoke samples do not establish tail latency
